meta.title: Therapy & Counselling — NestSelf
meta.description: Licensed psychologists and qualified psychotherapists for confidential individual sessions — online or in person.

hero.title: Therapy & Counselling
hero.lead: Talk to licensed psychologists and qualified psychotherapists about what is on your mind — stress, anxiety, relationships, grief or anything else. Sessions are confidential, and your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed.

items.title: Stress and burnout
items.body: Recognise the signs early and develop practical coping strategies with professional guidance.

items.title: Anxiety and low mood
items.body: Understand what you are feeling and work through it with a qualified professional at your own pace.

items.title: Relationships and family
items.body: Navigate challenges in your relationships, parenting or family life with confidential support.

items.title: Grief and change
items.body: Process loss, life transitions or major changes with someone who listens without judgement.

items.title: Sleep
items.body: Identify what keeps you awake and build healthier sleep habits with evidence-based approaches.

items.title: Conflict at work
items.body: Talk through workplace tensions, difficult colleagues or role changes in a safe, confidential space.

howItWorks.title: How it works

steps.title: 50-minute sessions
steps.body: Each session lasts 50 minutes — enough time to go deeper than a quick check-in.

steps.title: Video or in person
steps.body: Choose video sessions from anywhere, or meet in person where available.

steps.title: Serbian, Hungarian or English
steps.body: Sessions are available in the language you are most comfortable in.

steps.title: Follow-ups when you need them
steps.body: Book follow-up sessions at your own pace. Your notes and progress stay with you between sessions.

whoYouTalkTo.title: Who you will talk to
paragraphs: Every professional on NestSelf is a licensed psychologist or qualified psychotherapist, vetted through a structured selection process.
They use evidence-based methods and participate in regular supervision. You will never be matched with someone unqualified.

crisis.title: If you need help right now
crisis.body: If you or someone you know is in immediate danger, call the emergency number now.

items.question: Will my employer know I used this service?
items.answer: No. Your employer never learns who used NestSelf or what was discussed. HR sees anonymised usage for groups of 10 or more.

items.question: Is this therapy or counselling?
items.answer: Both. Our professionals include licensed psychologists and qualified psychotherapists who offer different approaches depending on your needs. You do not need to decide in advance — your professional will guide the conversation.

items.question: How many sessions can I have?
items.answer: The number of sessions depends on your employer's plan. Before you book, the platform shows your remaining coverage so there are no surprises.

items.question: Can my family members use this?
items.answer: Where your employer's plan includes family members, your partner and children can access the same therapy and counselling services.

items.question: How are professionals selected?
items.answer: Every professional is a licensed psychologist or qualified psychotherapist. They go through a structured vetting process and participate in regular supervision.

items.question: What if I do not connect with my professional?
items.answer: You can switch to a different professional at any time, no questions asked.

items.question: Are sessions recorded?
items.answer: No. Sessions are never recorded. Notes are visible only to you and your professional.

items.question: What methods do professionals use?
items.answer: Our professionals use evidence-based methods, including cognitive-behavioural therapy, psychodynamic approaches and integrative techniques, tailored to your needs.
